scope: MILESTONE: the client's entity count is 1 for the first time - the entity list is no longer empty

what_each_field_shows.count = 1: the count store executed and the byte read from buffer[164] was 0x01, exactly as built
what_each_field_shows.bitpos = 1309: the two gate bits advanced the position from 1307 to 1309, which matches the code - the gate reads are the only bit consumers before the count
what_each_field_shows.ids all zero: the 12-bit id loop has not run yet at this instruction; it starts at 0x6716A1, right after the store

why_this_is_the_milestone: every body this project ever produced left the count at 0 and the client drew nothing
two independent fixes were required and both are now known: bit 1307 = 1 (the gate) and the count byte at buffer[164]
the entity path is therefore OPEN, and what remains is the payload that follows the count
what_remains: the loop at 0x6716A1 reads 12 bits per entity id from the bit stream starting at position 1309
our body's bits 1309..1320 are whatever the ps block currently holds, so the id decoded will be arbitrary
the client exited again after the run, so the next requirement is a body where the 12-bit id and the following payload are both well formed
next: build a body that places a chosen 12-bit entity id at bit 1309 and leaves the rest of the ps block intact, then check that the id appears at 0x7859358 and whether the client survives
